termsPage.title: Operating rules, mandatory partner credentials, and settlement framework.
termsPage.intro: Defines UAV PAS's role as an intermediary software platform, required legal/aviation documents for UAV providers, and milestone settlement rules.
termsPage.sec1Title: 1. Role of the UAV PAS Software Platform
termsPage.sec1Body: UAV PAS provides GIS flight planning software, airspace safety checks, telemetry monitoring, encrypted deliverable storage, and digital coordination between Clients and independent UAV Service Providers. Field flight operations are executed by verified partner operators.
termsPage.sec2Body: Before publishing listings or accepting coordinated orders, each Fleet Partner must file and maintain verified documents in Partner Profile:
termsPage.doc1: Business Registration Certificate or legal representative government ID / Passport.
termsPage.doc2: Remote Pilot Certificate and aircraft serial / technical registration records.
termsPage.doc3: Commercial flight operation authorization / airspace permit and third-party liability insurance.
termsPage.doc4: Signed Platform Service Fee Schedule Addendum & Settlement Policy acknowledgment.
termsPage.doc5: Tax registration dossier and verified corporate/beneficiary bank account for payout reconciliation.
termsPage.sec3Title: 3. Escrow Holding, Deliverable Acceptance & Fee Schedule Addendum
termsPage.sec3Body: Illustrative escrow records are tracked per order reference. Platform service rates follow the live platform configuration for each Fleet Partner plan and settle only after the Customer confirms deliverable acceptance.

aboutPage.heroImageAlt: Field technician preparing multirotor UAV equipment before a survey flight.
aboutPage.title: Managed UAV flight service coordination & flight simulation platform.
aboutPage.scopeBody: UAV PAS is a software engineering capstone project designed and built by Nguyen Phat. The platform operates as an intermediary coordinating UAV flight services with map-based flight simulation and multi-portal order management.
aboutPage.scopeIllustrativeNote: This academic scope does not execute physical flights or live bank charges; all service prices, escrow balances, and settlement wallets are displayed as illustrative figures to verify the end-to-end workflow.
aboutPage.pillar1Desc: Customers select a service and draw a project flight zone; UAV PAS reviews the order and dispatches a verified fleet partner.
aboutPage.pillar2Desc: Built to validate dispatch workflows, grid flight path generation, Fail-safe commands, and live delivery-style order tracking.
aboutPage.pillar3Desc: Customer Portal for project bookings, Fleet Partner Portal for pilot & UAV assignment, and Admin Portal for verification & dispatch.
aboutPage.creditsBannerText: Public-domain photography is attributed in full on the credits page.

faqPage.title: Quick answers about how UAV PAS works.
faqPage.intro: Common questions about project-based booking, verified fleet coordination, simulated flight tracking, and fleet partner onboarding.
faqPage.q1: Do customers pick a specific fleet on UAV PAS?
faqPage.a1: No. Customers choose a flight service and subscribe it to their project. UAV PAS verifies partner credentials and dispatches a suitable verified fleet near the project area.
faqPage.q2: How do pricing and payments work on the platform?
faqPage.a2: All service rates, estimates, escrow holds, and settlement wallets are illustrative values used to demonstrate and validate the academic project workflow.
faqPage.q3: Are flights on the platform physical or simulated?
faqPage.a3: UAV PAS focuses on service coordination and map-based flight simulation including grid paths, progress, battery, link metrics, and Fail-safe commands rather than physical outdoor flight control.
faqPage.q4: How do I schedule recurring flights for the same project?
faqPage.a4: Create a Project, draw the flight polygon once on the map, and pick One-time, Weekly, or Monthly scheduling. Subsequent flight orders stay grouped under that project.
faqPage.q5: How can I track my flight order progress?
faqPage.a5: Every order shows a 5-stage status bar from Pending, Scheduled, In flight, and Delivered to Review, plus a simulated flight tracking map with planned waypoints, flown track, and UAV marker.
faqPage.q6: Can I cancel an order before takeoff?
faqPage.a6: Yes. You can cancel an order directly from the Customer Portal as long as the simulated flight has not started.
faqPage.q7: How can a fleet owner receive orders from UAV PAS?
faqPage.a7: Submit a Fleet Partner profile, register UAV airframes and control engineers, and create service listings from templates. Once approved by an administrator, your fleet receives dispatched orders.
faqPage.q8: Where do I inspect deliverables after a flight?
faqPage.a8: Once the assigned fleet completes handover, you can open deliverables directly inside the order detail view, confirm acceptance, and leave a star rating.
